historical_manifest_claim.exactBehavior: Options > thumbnails > interaction stages the exact original controls, imports independent legacy keys, applies to live consumers, preserves saved values on Cancel and reopens persisted drafts. The independent saved last-hit option changes non-Shift movement-key starting priority after Shift selection. Actual recorded consecutive click/Shift/right/Shift/right histories preserve focused-versus-last-hit distinction, selected ranges and range shrinking. The original move_focus API retains default behavior; the actual SearchPage consumer reads the live setting.
limits: Exactly these three original Missing leaves are proposed; no preview-focus preference is implemented or promoted. Broader Thumbnails/interaction families remain Partial.
The native regular grid has vertical reveal/wheel consumers. Horizontal scrolling, direct scrollbar wheel input and full graphics-view/masonry layouts remain outside this slice.

Winit normalizes a line tick to60px; the native consumer uses the recorded Qt default of3 wheel lines with a page cap. Physical-pixel smooth deltas use this scale; platform wheel-line settings and Qt fractional wheel accumulation are not ported.
Nonfinite/out-of-signed-int rates retain the prior native step without reproducing Qt conversion exceptions; raw accepted text remains saved. Invalid text silently keeps the prior saved string.
Native actual pointer/key/wheel replays and thumbnail-navigation.png are authored pending hosted CI. No local Cargo builds/tests, mutation runs, pushes or canonical inventory edits were performed.
